description: Erection of an outbuilding for use as a garden room/shed
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, 1365 101 and 1365 102 [received on 21 February 2019], and amended Block Plan [received on 4 April 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be as shown on the approved plans

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 11 Fairfax Road, W4 1EN, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
